newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnights rise before market operation.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnights rise before market operation.

text.p: Pakistani overnight rates rose to 16 percent on Friday from Thursday's 11 percent close after the State (central) Bank of Pakistan announced a special open market operation (OMO) for Saturday, dealers said.
The bank announced the OMO before the close and rates climbed in response, one dealer of Standard Chartered Bank said.
Another dealer said the outcome of the OMO would determine which way overnight rates moved next.
